blocks.text: Actress-entrepreneur Kiray Celis has officially welcomed motherhood as she announced the arrival of her first child with her husband, Stephan Estopia. Celis announced the news through a video on her Instagram page, showing her at the hospital and sharing a glimpse of her newborn son, whose name has yet to be revealed. “Magpa-Pasko at Bagong Taon na kasama ang pinakamagandang regalo galing kay Lord,” she said.
